test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 03 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error’.

Soap removes traces of pesticides and heavy metals that hand sanitizers can left behind.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3' **i.e. **'sanitizers can left behind.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error in this sentence is the incorrect verb form **'left'** following** 'can'.** 
 
• The correct verb form should be the base form** 'leave'.** 

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'**Soap removes traces of pesticides and heavy metals that hand sanitizers can leave behind.'*
